name: CKEditor 5 Bootstrap Carousel
description: Insert and edit a Bootstrap 5 carousel in CKEditor 5.
project_description: The CKEditor 5 Bootstrap Carousel module lets editors insert and edit a responsive Bootstrap 5 carousel (slideshow) directly inside the CKEditor 5 WYSIWYG interface, without paragraphs or entity-reference fields. It ships a CKEditor 5 plugin (built with CKEditor 5's TypeScript plugin APIs) plus a companion text-format filter, 'Carousel enabler', that adds the Bootstrap data attributes and generates the indicator and control buttons at render time. Carousels work out of the box on any site whose front-end theme already loads Bootstrap 5's CSS and JavaScript.
